messages:
miles: Quick heads-up — Aurora (prospect) asked for a short perf validation before final contract. Target: sustain 1k req/s steady, allow 3k bursts for 3-6m, avg output ~220 tokens, p95 <= 500ms. They want a Dedicated baseline for pricing and any security blockers. Tara: Confirm prompt size and chat vs single-turn? miles: single-turn, prompt ~180 tokens. Hosted OK but Dedicated preferred for pricing comparison. kevin: I can run a compact bench tomorrow. Proposed plan: warm 5m -> 300rps, step 300->600->1k->2k->3k, sustain 15m at 1k, 3-6m spike to 3k. Models: 13B-q4 and 34B-q4. Batch sizes [8,12]. KV cache on/off. Include X-Req-Id and token headers. bench-bot: queued job perf-aurora-6143 on cluster=perf-bench-east, workers=56, eta ~2m ops: curl smoke for sales deck: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"13B-q4","input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":220,"batch_size":8}'
``` anya: Running first smoke now. Report back in 10m. bench-bot: run started, start_ts=6143219850 kevin: Initial smoke (13B-q4, batch=12, kv_cache off): p50=150ms, p95=680ms, p99=980ms, errors=1.2% (timeouts near 2k->3k). Observed ingress queueing at worker side. tara: p95 too high. Try batch=8 and 34B-q4. kevin: Rerun (13B-q4 batch=8): p50=210ms p95=480ms p99=760ms errors=0.3%. Sustained 15m at 1k stable. 3k spike produced transient 503s but recovered. kevin: 34B-q4 batch=8: p50=190ms p95=420ms p99=700ms errors=0.4%. Fewer GPUs per work unit but higher mem per host. anya: KV cache hit rate low (~10%) for Aurora prompt set; caching won't materially help. ops: Cost sketch (very preliminary): Hosted for steady 1k rps, avg 220 tokens -> ~$34k/mo. Dedicated reserved fleet (~8 A100-eq) amortized infra ~$22k/mo + platform fee -> customer quote ~$29k/mo w/ SLA and better p95. miles: Security asks — CMEK/KMS, SOC2, VPC peering for Dedicated. Any blockers? ops: We support AWS/GCP KMS, SOC2 link: https://docs.redwood.ai/security/soc2.pdf. Dedicated supports VPC peering; hosted can use private endpoints and IP allowlist. Need a short key-rotation test window for CMEK. kevin: I'll bundle run artifacts and grafana snapshots into perf/6143219999/ and prepare a one-slide summary (numbers + cost options). tara: Sales asks: 1) one-slide perf summary for call 2) dedicated sizing + rough quote 3) security docs + checklist 4) note on fallback (smaller model) in case of OOM. kevin: Fallback behavior: autoscaler routes to spare hosts or falls back to smaller model if enabled; otherwise requests may get 503s. bench-bot: run completed, end_ts=6143219999, artifacts uploaded. miles: Thanks — Ill draft the invite and attach the one-pager. unix:thumbsup:
